cases.sectionSubtitle: Engineering challenges from real-world systems, from financial platforms to vehicle tracking.

tacweb.title: TacWeb: stabilizing a vehicle tracking platform
tacweb.problem: TacWeb, Sascar’s vehicle tracking and monitoring system, was weighed down by several legacy systems, a massive database that frequently locked up and inconsistent data, putting the platform’s most important customer, Besalco, at risk.
tacweb.solution: Technical leadership of the project: diagnosing and fixing the database lockups, the legacy system issues and the data inconsistencies, working directly with Besalco’s team in Spanish.
tacweb.result: Platform stabilized and its most important customer retained.

mismoConversion.title: Bidirectional MISMO conversion layer
mismoConversion.problem: A mortgage loan origination platform needed to import and export loan data in the industry-standard MISMO XML format while preserving its internal model.
mismoConversion.solution: A bidirectional interoperability layer with mapping, validation and version compatibility, enabling consistent import and export.

lenderSync.title: Defensive lender synchronization
lenderSync.problem: Lender integrations could return partial XML. Applying the payload as-is would wipe out fields users had already filled in.
lenderSync.solution: A defensive sync strategy that preserves existing data whenever the external payload carries no new value.

resilientIntegration.title: Resilient third-party integrations
resilientIntegration.problem: Integrations with external systems suffered from intermittent failures, timeouts and inconsistent responses.
resilientIntegration.solution: Retries with exponential backoff, circuit breakers, background jobs, structured logging and monitoring for dependable processing.

securitiesRegistry.title: Fixed-income securities registration
securitiesRegistry.problem: A financial institution needed to exchange fixed-income securities data with Brazil’s CIP/C3 registration platform.
securitiesRegistry.solution: An integration with an XML conversion layer between the registration platform and internal banking systems, using asynchronous messaging.

items.question: Does WSS IT build systems from scratch?
items.answer: Yes. We build custom systems from a real business need or process, going through discovery, planning, incremental development and delivery.

items.question: Can you integrate systems we already use?
items.answer: Yes. Integration is one of our core specialties: internal systems, third-party APIs, financial platforms and legacy software, using REST, XML, webhooks and messaging.

items.question: Do you take over existing or legacy systems?
items.answer: Yes. We diagnose production bugs, analyze performance, fix broken integrations and modernize step by step, without rewriting everything at once.

items.question: Can we hire just a technical assessment?
items.answer: Yes. Architecture reviews, code reviews and technical planning are available as standalone engagements, with no full project required.

items.question: Do you work with companies outside Brazil?
items.answer: Yes. We have ongoing experience with the U.S. market and work remotely in English and Portuguese.

items.question: How does the quote process work?
items.answer: You describe the problem, idea or opportunity. We review the context, talk through open questions and come back with a technical and commercial proposal.
